verdict.rationale: Morph documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL (https://api.morphllm.com/v1) with chat completions and /v1/messages, but no evidence documents a GET /v1/models or equivalent endpoint for enumerating the live model catalog programmatically. OpenAI SDK compatibility alone does not establish that a models-listing endpoint exists, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
